name: liquid_tag_math_pipeline
source:
{%- liquid
  assign values = "15, 8, 23, 4, 42, 16, 7, 31" | split: ", "
  assign sum = 0
  assign count = 0
  assign max = 0
  for v in values
    assign n = v | plus: 0
    assign sum = sum | plus: n
    assign count = count | plus: 1
    if n > max
      assign max = n
    endif
  endfor
  assign avg = sum | divided_by: count
  assign remainder = sum | modulo: count
  echo "sum=" | append: sum | append: " count=" | append: count | append: " avg=" | append: avg | append: " max=" | append: max | append: " mod=" | append: remainder
-%}

name: liquid_tag_csv_parser
source:
{%- liquid
  assign csv = "name:age:city,Alice:30:NYC,Bob:25:LA,Carol:35:Chicago" | split: ","
  assign count = 0
  for row in csv
    if forloop.first
      continue
    endif
    assign fields = row | split: ":"
    assign age = fields[1] | plus: 0
    if age >= 30
      assign count = count | plus: 1
      echo fields[0]
      echo " ("
      echo fields[2]
      echo ")"
      unless forloop.last
        echo ", "
      endunless
    endif
  endfor
  echo " [" | append: count | append: " found]"
-%}

name: liquid_tag_accumulator_with_capture
source:
{%- liquid
  assign words = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" | split: " "
  assign unique_count = 0
  assign seen = ""
  for word in words
    assign lower = word | downcase
    assign check = seen | split: "," | where: lower
    if check.size == 0
      assign unique_count = unique_count | plus: 1
      if seen != ""
        assign seen = seen | append: ","
      endif
      assign seen = seen | append: lower
    endif
  endfor
  assign sorted_unique = seen | split: "," | sort | join: ", "
  echo unique_count | append: " unique: " | append: sorted_unique
-%}
